about.storyText: Altitude Music was founded in 2023 as a non-profit, but the collective has been around since 2018. Since then, we've been a key player in the Louvain-la-Neuve music scene. Our mission is to support and develop the artistic potential of young creators, putting hip-hop music forward as a means of artistic expression.
about.teamText: Production, mix, master, cover art, music videos… Our team brings everything together to move your project forward, from sound to image.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.intro: Legal information about altitudemusic.be, published by the non-profit Altitude Music ASBL.
legal.privacyText: The site only collects personal data that you send us yourself:
legal.privacyForms: Contact and testimonial forms: name, email and message go through Netlify Forms and are kept as long as needed to handle your request.
legal.privacyBooking: Bookings: name, email and time slot are processed by Cal.com and stored in the studio's calendar to organise the session.
legal.privacyEmbeds: YouTube videos and Instagram posts: nothing is loaded from those services until you click a thumbnail; they may then set their own cookies.
legal.privacyAnalytics: No audience measurement tool or advertising cookie is used.
legal.rights: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data at altitudemusic13@gmail.com.
